_about: Console releases the browser core can't run, by LaunchBox platform and ROM file name. The site plays another release of the game when one works, and offers the flagged one as 'Try anyway'. Sega Saturn (2026-09-18): every release was started in the browser player and watched for two to three minutes, with buttons pressed; a release is here when it freezes the page every time, stops on a screen it never leaves (checked by eye), or goes black and stops reading its disc in every way it was tried, in the browser and in native Yabause. The last kind are probable rather than certain: Astal, Bedlam, Clockwork Knight: Pepperouchau's Adventure, Decathlete (Athlete Kings), Hebereke's Popoitto, Mortal Kombat II, Mr. Bones, Primal Rage, Robotica, SimCity 2000, Terry Pratchett's Discworld, Virtua Cop, VR Golf '97 (Actua Golf), WipEout. Yabause in LaunchBox's RetroArch fails the same way; Beetle Saturn plays the ones tried, so the discs are fine.
